## LinuxServer.io MCP Server v0.1.1

### Summary
Initial public community release of the LinuxServer.io MCP Server with LSIO-aligned scaffolding, validation, guidance tooling, testing, and release automation.

### Highlights
- New tools/features:
  - `lsio.validate_spec` for LSIO-oriented spec validation.
  - `lsio.generate_scaffold` for Dockerfile, README, and Compose starter output.
  - `lsio.get_guidance_links` for authoritative LSIO docs/support references.
  - `lsio.get_best_practices` for LSIO implementation/review checklists.
- Improvements:
  - Expanded LSIO standards governance in Copilot instructions.
  - Added LSIO-style file header/comment standards in source and workflows.
  - Added release runbook, changelog, and release template.
- Fixes:
  - Strengthened TypeScript strict typing and release preflight scripts.
  - Added test gating to CI and publish workflows.

### Validation
- [x] `npm run build`
- [x] `npm test`
- [x] MCP server startup smoke test (`node dist/index.js`)
- [x] Package dry-run (`npm pack --dry-run`)

### LSIO Standards Check
- [x] LSIO docs alignment verified
- [x] PUID/PGID and directory guidance still accurate
- [x] No implied official LSIO endorsement without explicit approval

### Upgrade Notes
- Breaking changes: None
- Migration notes: First tagged release (`v0.1.1`)
